title: Do You Like It? site rules
description: Tells the extension how to hide prices and find products on one shopping site. Data only: CSS selectors and settings, never code.

selector.description: One CSS selector. No commas: list each selector separately.

selectorGroups.description: Named groups of selectors (e.g. price, discount) so users can switch groups separately.

domains.description: Registrable domains. Subdomains match automatically (amazon.in covers www.amazon.in).

currency.description: Default ISO 4217 currency, used when a price has no symbol or only an ambiguous one like "$".

regions.description: Per-domain display name and currency, for sites with one store per country (amazon.com, amazon.co.uk…). Keys must be listed in domains.

hide.description: Covered with a striped placeholder. Selectors in the "price" group also get a fixed width, so the placeholder doesn't reveal how long the price is.

remove.description: Removed from the page (price filters, sort-by-price options, EMI offers).

product.description: Product cards on listing and search pages. Powers the ❤️ button.

price.description: Read when a product is liked, so the picks list can show it later.

urlPattern.description: Regex on the URL path; capture group 1 is the product id.

productUrl.description: Clean product link, with {id} for the product id and optionally {domain} for the store's domain.

ignore.description: Areas the generic ₹ detector should skip.
